context: Tests whether the agent correctly renders a bottom-up thermometer on a top-indexed 6-segment Govee H6056 LED bar, applies the correct 3-zone color gradient, uses the Govee-correct OFF value, and registers a shutdown hook.

checklist.name: Top-indexed lit formula
checklist.description: The lit segment range is computed as `(total - lit) until total` (or equivalent: `(6 - lit) until 6`) — NOT `0 until lit` or `0..lit`

checklist.name: Bottom-up fill direction
checklist.description: When signal level increases, newly lit segments are at the HIGH-index end (physically lower on the device) — NOT at index 0 (which is physically at the top). The code does NOT use `forEachIndexed { i, _ -> if (i < lit) ... }` or `(0 until lit)` for the lit range

checklist.name: Red zone always on
checklist.description: The bottom zone (physically segments 4 and 5, or the last two high-index segments) is set to RED whenever any level > 0 — it does NOT turn off at low levels

checklist.name: Yellow middle zone
checklist.description: The middle zone (segments 2 and 3, or equivalent) is set to YELLOW when level >= 1, and to OFF otherwise

checklist.name: Green top zone
checklist.description: The top zone (segments 0 and 1, or equivalent) is set to GREEN when level >= 2, and to OFF otherwise

checklist.name: Govee OFF value
checklist.description: The OFF color is defined as Triple(1, 1, 1) or rgb(1, 1, 1) — NOT Triple(0, 0, 0) or Color.BLACK or any zero-RGB value

checklist.name: Shutdown hook registered
checklist.description: A JVM shutdown hook is registered via Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(...) that sends an off command to all segments

checklist.name: Ktor CIO dependency
checklist.description: build.gradle.kts declares io.ktor:ktor-client-cio (or io.ktor:ktor-client-core) as a dependency — not OkHttp, Apache HttpClient, or java.net.HttpURLConnection

checklist.name: Logback/SLF4J dependency
checklist.description: build.gradle.kts includes ch.qos.logback:logback-classic or equivalent SLF4J implementation
